page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

The instance utilizes dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. Lacking advanced vector extensions, such as AVX or AVX-512, and specialized cryptographic accelerators, its processing capabilities are suited for standard workloads rather than dense mathematical or cryptographic operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides a resource-dense profile for memory-bound applications that do not require high compute core counts, minimizing expenditures on unnecessary vCPUs.

The ecs.s2.2xlarge is designed for workloads requiring moderate memory capacity relative to processing power. Suitable use cases include small-scale databases, caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
